title: Single-device platform credential, no attestation
description: Platform authenticator, BE=0 BS=0, non-discoverable. Classic device-bound single-device credential without attestation.

title: Backup-eligible but not currently backed up (BE=1 BS=0)
description: BE=1 BS=0: backup-eligible multi-device credential, not currently backed up. BE=1 establishes eligibility, not current sync state.

title: Currently backed up (BE=1 BS=1)
description: BE=1 BS=1: currently backed up multi-device credential. BS=1 when BE=1 indicates currently backed up.

title: Invalid combination BE=0 BS=1
description: BE=0 BS=1 is not allowed per WebAuthn L3 Table BE/BS combinations. Tests that BS=1 requires BE=1.

title: Device-bound passkey (discoverable, single-device) with attestation
description: Discoverable single-device: FIDO still calls this a passkey (device-bound passkey). BE=0 BS=0 even though passkey. Attestation presence alone without trusted metadata does not establish hardware binding.

title: Currently backed up passkey with packed attestation
description: BE=1 BS=1 discoverable with attestation. Attestation presence alone, without sufficient trusted metadata/evidence, does not establish hardware binding for this synthetic case.

title: Roaming authenticator, backup-eligible not currently backed up
description: Roaming authenticator that is still BE=1 BS=0: backup-eligible, not currently backed up. Roaming != automatically single-device / BE=0.

title: Platform authenticator, single-device, discoverable (device-bound passkey)
description: Platform authenticator BE=0 BS=0 discoverable: platform does not imply backup-eligible or currently backed up. Device-bound passkey.

title: Single-device, no attestation -- lack of attestation does not prove currently backed up
description: Roaming single-device without attestation. Lack of attestation does not prove currently backed up; BE/BS is authoritative.

title: Currently backed up, discoverable, no attestation (BS=1 when BE=1)
description: BE=1 BS=1 discoverable without attestation. Currently-backed-up state comes from BS=1 when BE=1, not from attestation or discoverability.
